record.context_brief: Weak embeddings of L1: sign to Gδ
record.original_question: If L_1 sign-embeds in a Banach space X, meaning that there is an injective operator T in L(L_1,X) and a constant δ > 0 such that ||Tx|| >= δ||x|| for every sign function x taking values in {-1,0,1}, must L_1 also G_delta-embed in X, meaning that there is an injective operator whose image of every closed bounded subset of L_1 is a G_delta subset of X?

evidence.quote: Definition 13.2. (J. Bourgain, H.P. Rosenthal, 1983) An injective operator T ∈ L(X, Y ) is called a Gδ-embedding if TK is a Gδ-set for each closed bounded K ⊂ X.

Definition 13.3. (H.P. Rosenthal, 1981) An injective operator T ∈ L(L1, X) is called a sign-embedding if kT xk ≥ δkxk for some δ > 0 and every sign x ∈ L1 (sign means that x takes values from {−1, 0, 1}).
Problem 13.4. A) Suppose that L1 sign-embeds in X. Does L1 Gδ-embed in X?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $L_1 = L_1[0,1]$ and let $X$ be a Banach space. An injective bounded linear operator $T: L_1 \to X$ is called a sign-embedding if there exists a constant $\delta > 0$ such that $\|Tx\| \geq \delta \|x\|$ for every sign function $x \in L_1$, i.e., every measurable function taking values in $\{-1,0,1\}$. An injective bounded linear operator $T: L_1 \to X$ is called a $G_\delta$-embedding if for every closed bounded subset $K \subseteq L_1$ the image $T(K)$ is a $G_\delta$ subset of $X$ (a countable intersection of open sets).

Question: Suppose there exists a sign-embedding of $L_1$ into $X$. Must there then exist a $G_\delta$-embedding of $L_1$ into $X$?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a published resolution of this question. The relationship between sign-embeddings (Rosenthal, 1981) and $G_\delta$-embeddings (Bourgain–Rosenthal, 1983) of $L_1$ has been studied, but no definitive recent reference confirming or refuting the implication was found, so the current status appears unknown from available sources.

status_evidence.title: Some Open Problems on Functional Analysis and Function Theory (zbMATH)
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 13.4 lists the question of whether L_1 sign-embedding into X implies L_1 G_delta-embedding into X.
status_evidence.claim: The question is posed as an open problem in a problems collection.

status_evidence.title: Coordinate systems and distributional embeddings in Bourgain-Rosenthal-Schechtman spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on Bourgain–Rosenthal–Schechtman spaces and embeddings of L_1 does not record a resolution of the sign- vs G_delta-embedding question.
status_evidence.claim: Recent related literature does not announce a solution.
